R4A-deer-atv-0005.name: 570 m S of Salmo River
R4A-deer-atv-0005.pressureWhy: Busier: under 30 minutes from a city (estimate).
R4A-deer-atv-0005.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Pend-d'Oreille Rd); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: Mule deer winter range u-4-001 unit 340 (official), right here. Counts from October.
Cutblock harvested 2018 (8 years old), right here.
Burn from 2017 (fire N51634, 410 ha), right here.
W facing slope, 13 degrees: sun melts snow first.
Private fields 70 m W: deer feed on field edges (fields are private).
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

flags.t: Route crosses private land (ParcelMap BC, updated 2026-10-09): get permission first or go around.
Private land 70 m W: no shooting within 100 m (109 yd) of an occupied house or farm building (synopsis page 10, 99%).

CWD (Chronic Wasting Disease) Management Zone, MU 4-8: every deer, elk and moose taken here must have its head sampled at a CWD freezer before you leave the zone (www.gov.bc.ca/CWDdropoff). Brain and spinal column (vertebrae, not the tail) may not leave the zone: leave them at the kill site or a landfill in it (synopsis pages 15, 36, 37, 99%).

Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: 4 point bucks: antlers must accompany the species licence
bag 2; private land only, with landowner permission

plan: Drive: from City of Rossland, about 48 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.01995, -117.36811, where the truck road ends (Pend-d'Oreille Rd); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 2.5 km on unnamed roads and trails by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 140 m N, climb about 0 m.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2018 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-8, Region 4. CWD zone: deer, elk and moose heads go to a CWD freezer; brain and spine stay in the zone. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R4A-deer-atv-0005.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 4-8: about 6,035 hunter days a year for mule deer and white tailed deer (2020 to 2024 mean), 2.79 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.1 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
